name: DIY Accident
description: {driver} lost a hand in a DIY accident.

name: Deal with the Devil
description: {driver} made a deal with the devil — supernatural talent, terrible price.

on_expire.description: {driver} exploded as the devil came to collect.

name: Career-Ending Scandal
description: {driver} was caught up in a scandal so severe it may define their legacy forever.

name: Fan Favourite
description: {driver} became an iconic fan favourite — their mere presence electrifies the grandstands.

name: Eagle Eyes
description: {driver} developed unnaturally sharp vision. Mechanics swear their eyes flash gold in low light.

name: Second Head
description: {driver} grew a second head during the offseason. It disagrees with every racing decision and has strong opinions on tyre strategy.

name: Third Arm
description: {driver} sprouted a third arm from their left shoulder. Gear changes have never been faster, but handshakes have become awkward.

name: Iron Skin
description: {driver}'s skin hardened to an unnatural degree. They shrug off crashes but can barely feel the steering wheel.

name: Enormous Growth
description: {driver} experienced an inexplicable growth spurt. The cockpit had to be rebuilt and they still don't fit properly.

name: Tentacle Arm
description: {driver}'s left arm has become... flexible in ways medical science cannot explain. The FIA is still debating whether it's legal.

name: Luminous Skin
description: {driver}'s skin developed a faint ethereal glow. Night-race marshals appreciate the visibility. Everyone else is unnerved.

name: Incredible Bone Density
description: {driver}'s bones became incredibly dense overnight. They are now the heaviest driver on the grid by a worrying margin.

name: Prehensile Toes
description: {driver}'s feet became fully prehensile. They operate pedals with disturbing precision and occasionally pick things up off the floor.

name: Third Eye
description: {driver} developed a third eye on their forehead. Peripheral vision has never been better. Helmet fitting has never been worse.

name: Venomous Spit
description: {driver} developed the ability to spit mildly corrosive venom. Mechanics have learned to stand well back during debriefs.

name: Magnetic Hands
description: {driver}'s hands became slightly magnetic. Watches stop, phones die, but their grip on the wheel is extraordinary.

name: Webbed Fingers
description: {driver}'s fingers became partially webbed. Gloves no longer fit but their hands never slip on the wheel, even in rain.

name: Sudden Hirsutism
description: {driver} became extremely hairy almost overnight. The helmet barely fits and the visor fogs up constantly.

name: Colour-Changing Eyes
description: {driver}'s eyes change colour with mood. Crimson during overtakes, cerulean on cool-down laps, worrying purple during team radio.

name: Demonic Possession
description: {driver}'s driving became terrifyingly aggressive and their eyes occasionally flash red during interviews. The team chaplain is concerned.

name: Cursed Helmet
description: {driver} bought a vintage helmet from a suspicious antiques dealer. Everyone who touches it except them gets a splitting headache.

name: Fae Bargain
description: {driver} wandered into a fairy ring and struck a deal — otherworldly talent, but they must return when the magic fades.

on_expire.description: {driver} vanished into a fairy ring after the final race. The car was found idling, seat empty, with wildflowers growing through the cockpit.

name: Haunted Garage
description: {driver}'s garage is haunted by a 1950s racing driver's ghost who keeps sabotaging the telemetry and tutting at modern aero.

name: Phoenix Rebirth
description: {driver} walked out of a massive fireball crash completely unscathed with a strange golden aura. Something feels different about them.

name: Alien Abduction
description: {driver} claims to have been abducted by aliens over winter. They returned with strange aerodynamic knowledge and a fear of bright lights.

name: Spider Bite
description: {driver} was bitten by a radioactive spider at a factory tour. Nothing happened, but they insist they can 'sense danger now'.

name: Espionage Scandal
description: {driver} was caught sneaking into a rival factory dressed as a janitor. The disguise included a fake moustache and a camera-mop.

name: Match Fixing Investigation
description: {driver} is under investigation for fixing race results through an underground betting syndicate run from a kebab shop.

name: Identity Fraud
description: {driver} has been racing under a fabricated identity for years. Nobody knows their real name, age, or nationality.

name: Underground Racing Ring
description: {driver} ran an illegal street racing league across three continents. The FIA found out when they accidentally won their own event.

name: Body Double Exposed
description: {driver} was caught using a body double for media appearances while they stayed home playing video games.
